mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_relation_user_lock(user_id) VALUES(#{user}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE user_id=VALUES(user_id)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_following WHERE from_user_id=#{user} AND type=1

SELECT id, from_user_id AS fromUserId, to_user_id AS toUserId, type, version, update_time AS updateTime FROM t_following WHERE from_user_id=#{user} AND type=1 ORDER BY update_time DESC,to_user_id DESC

SELECT id, from_user_id AS fromUserId, to_user_id AS toUserId, type, version, update_time AS updateTime FROM t_follower WHERE to_user_id=#{user} AND type=1 ORDER BY update_time DESC,from_user_id DESC LIMIT #{offset},#{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_follower(id,from_user_id,to_user_id,type,version,update_time) VALUES(#{id},#{fromUserId},#{toUserId},#{type},#{version},#{updateTime}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE type=IF(VALUES(version)>version,VALUES(type),type), update_time=IF(VALUES(version)>version,VALUES(update_time),update_time), version=GREATEST(version,VALUES(version))
